description: The IsProduction condition is defined as Fn::Equals [EnvironmentType, "staging"], so its name asserts production while its logic tests for staging. The Quality Review Source (iacreview.quality) reports the contradiction via condition_name_logic_mismatch. The condition gates ConfigBucket, so it is not also flagged as unused, and EnvironmentType is referenced by both the condition and a tag, so it is not flagged as an unused parameter. The bucket is fully compliant -- encrypted, private, versioned, access-logged, retained, and tagged -- so no other deterministic Source fires and the case isolates the one condition-logic finding.

expected_findings.note: A condition named IsProduction that tests for the staging literal, reported by the condition_name_logic_mismatch detector.
